observations: Actual main page played six videos concurrently: three1920x1080 and three1280x720, roughly24-30fps.
Active camera timer requests updates every0.4s; table_html constructs the entire current event table even if rows are unchanged.
Force refresh fetches all events and rebuilds rows from diagnostics.
All tab definitions are constructed before application launch; missing browser caches can also trigger synchronous ffmpeg from _ensure_clip.
Before login, no video DOM elements were present in the inspected browser; do not claim all12 videos buffer/play in browser simultaneously.
limitations: Process CPU/RSS inspection via ps was denied by sandbox; no live process CPU attribution.
No supported browser dropped-frame counter was available; no dropped-frame percentage claimed.
Measurements are local samples; cached build time is not complete cold start or inference FPS.
recommended_order: Avoid unchanged full-table HTML updates; keep actual playhead polling.
